developer_shortcut.renderer_freshness: Before a cold repository launch, compute a deterministic fingerprint over Renderer build inputs and rebuild ui/dist when the recorded build fingerprint is missing or stale. The presence of dist/index.html alone is not freshness evidence.
developer_shortcut.hidden_existing_window_activation: Ask the owning Electron process to reveal its BrowserWindow through a user-scoped local activation pipe; if that channel is unavailable after the bounded first-window fallback, trigger the native second-instance path and wait for visibility. A process without a visible window is not a successful launch.

uninstall_user_data.checkbox_label: 同时删除用户配置和运行数据（无法恢复）

release_installer.release_gate: A packaged Windows smoke test must prove install, cold-start window visibility, hidden-window second-launch recovery, single-instance focus, clean exit, uninstall, and shortcut removal before public release.
